scheme_name: Theka Shramik, Hamaal Shramik Evan Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Gambhir Bimaari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the State Social Security Board at least 90 days in advance
Applicant can receive benefits only once
If the applicant has received benefits from any other parallel scheme of the State Government, they are not eligible
benefits_summary: Medical aid of up to ₹50,000 is provided for treatment of serious illnesses such as kidney disease, cancer, sickle cell anemia, heart disease, AIDS, and paralysis.
